title: Tracking the US military buildup in the Caribbean — The Conversation (satellite analysis)
snippet: Satellite imagery and AIS tracking data reveal unprecedented US military buildup in the Caribbean region: 3 Carrier Strike Groups, F-35 stealth fighters, AC-130 gunships, and Iwo Jima Amphibious Ready Group deployed. Imagery shows naval assets concentrated near Venezuela and surrounding waters. Open-source analysts cross-reference commercial satellite passes with ADS-B/AIS transponder data.
